analysis.title: Apollo Global Management: Origination Flywheel Underpins 2027 Growth; Reiterate OW
key_insights: MS reiterates Overweight on APO with a $149 PT (from $150), about 31% upside from the $113.55 close on Nov 3, 2026. The PT reflects ~11.6x 2028e EPS.
Management reiterated 2026 targets of 20%+ FRE growth and 10% SRE growth, and gave a first look at 2027: 20%+ FRE growth, 15%+ management fee growth and 10% SRE growth.
MS 2027e EPS of $11.00 is about 4% above consensus of $10.61, driven by higher ACS fees, fee-related performance fees and realized performance fees.
3Q26 ANI of $2.15 ex-notables ($2.07 reported) missed MSe of $2.24 by 9c and consensus of $2.19 by 4c, on lower SRE and a higher tax rate of 21.6% vs MS 19.2%. FRE beat on record ACS fees.
Record origination of $114b in 3Q26, with more than 80% IG. LTM origination reached $356b. ACS fees hit a record $290m, the sixth straight quarter above $200m, across more than 115 transactions.
Broadcom has not yet contributed to ACS fees because of capital draw timing and fee structure, which MS sees as upside to ACS in coming quarters.

MS 2027e FRE is $3.85b (+23% y/y), about 4% above consensus of $3.71b. The gap comes from ACS fees ($1.26b vs cons $1.20b) and fee-related performance fees ($425m vs cons $334m). MS management fees of $4.66b are about 2% below the Street.
MS 2027e FRE margin is 60.8%, about 150bps above consensus of 59.3%. 2027e PII of $636m is about 24% above consensus of $511m on realized performance fees of $2.16b vs cons $1.74b.

The 2027 management fee outlook already reflects lost fees from MFIC (which Ares agreed to acquire after quarter end) and ARI, and includes only ~2% from Fund X and Fund XI, with the fee switch to Fund XI assumed around mid-year.

On AI financing, mgmt focuses on power and chips. Chip financings fully amortize with no assumed residual value and IG guarantees, with single-A chip financings yielding 8.5-9%. Athene's digital infrastructure exposure is ~3% and Apollo's is ~2.5-3% in aggregate.
Mgmt expects AI-related issuers to reach 12-15% of the IG index over the next two years and would keep its own exposure at roughly half to two-thirds of index weights.

SRE ex-notables was $909m ($963m normalized for an 11% alts return), up 1% q/q and 9% y/y. A $65m unfavorable notable item came from Athene's annual actuarial assumption review. Net spread ex-notables was 114bps (121bps normalized), within the 120-125bps full-year outlook.

Cost of funds rose faster than asset yields because assets were deployed late in the quarter. More than 60% of new investments were deployed in September and should fully earn in during 4Q, supporting mgmt's ~$1b 4Q normalized SRE.
MS models 4Q26 SRE of $1,014m vs consensus of $971m, and 2027 SRE of $4.26b vs consensus of $4.19b. MS is about 2% below the Street on 2028 SRE ($4.58b vs $4.67b) on a flattish net spread.
Athene gross inflows were $18.7b in 3Q, 11% below MSe and 7% below consensus. MS models 2026e inflows of $83.6b (cons $84.7b) and 2027e of $88b (cons $90.7b).

Mgmt pointed to the NAIC's October 26 memo on regulatory arbitrage in offshore jurisdictions and expects meaningful change in 2027, which would ease pricing pressure from less capitalized competitors and let spreads widen.

APO plans about $350m of spend over 24 months to build private market infrastructure (daily pricing, ICE IDs, custody and settlement starting with credit in 2027). Mgmt treats it as a one-off excluded from ANI.
Mgmt expects to trade more than $40b of private assets by year-end. AMAPS together with APADS reached $40b in about a year.
3Q fundraising was $53.5b, 10% above MSe and in line with consensus. FPAUM was $880b. Inflows of $53b keep asset management on track for a record year.

MS cut 2026e EPS 2.1% to $8.59 (from $8.77), 2027e 2.9% to $11.00 (from $11.33) and 2028e 4.2% to $12.80 (from $13.36), mainly on the 3Q miss, lower management fees from MFIC and ARI losses, and higher cost of funds.
At ~10.9x 2027e P/E, APO trades at a discount to peers (~13x). MS sees ~22% EPS CAGR through 2028.

market_movers.rationale: Record origination, growing ACS fees and a constructive 2027 guide support above-consensus growth. MS 2027e EPS is about 4% above the Street despite a 3Q miss on SRE and tax.

sector_views.rationale: MS industry view is In-Line. APO is positioned to benefit from rising private market allocations from wealth and insurance channels and global investment in energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, defense and AI.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 APO ANI per share $2.15 ex-notables (reported $2.07 including the $65m actuarial unlock), vs MSe $2.24 and consensus $2.19. Reported 11/4/2026 preview-to-print comparison, so this is a printed result.
3Q26 FRE reported $802m, vs MSe $782m and consensus $787m. ACS fees were $290m, 19% above MSe and 14% above consensus. Management fees were $1,017m, 2.0% below MSe.
3Q26 SRE ex-notables reported $909m, vs MSe $953m and consensus $931m. Net spread ex-notables was 114bps, 5bps below MSe and 3bps below consensus.
3Q26 PII reported $52m, in line with MSe $50m and above consensus $38m. Realized performance fees were $362m vs MSe $185m, offset by a PII compensation ratio of 85% vs MS 70%.
3Q26 tax rate was 21.6% vs MS 19.2%, worth -7c vs MSe. Fundraising was $53.5b vs MSe $48.6b and consensus $53.2b. Athene gross inflows were $18.7b vs MSe $21.0b and consensus $20.3b.

Mgmt 2026 targets (reiterated): 20%+ FRE growth (MSe 24%, consensus 24%) and 10% normalized SRE growth assuming an 11% alts return (MSe 10%, consensus 9%). 4Q26 normalized SRE expected at ~$1b (MSe $1,014m, consensus $971m).

Mgmt 2027 targets (new): 20%+ FRE growth (MSe 23%, consensus 19%), 15%+ management fee growth (MSe 16%, consensus 17%) and 10% SRE growth off the normalized 2026 base (MSe 11%, consensus 10%). More detail on 2027 margins is due on the 4Q call.
MS estimates (forecasts): 2026e EPS $8.59, 2027e EPS $11.00 (consensus $10.61 per the report text), 2028e EPS $12.80. 4Q26e ACS fees $296m vs consensus $281m.
risk_factors: Concerns around balance sheet exposure and a potential credit cycle.
Slower deployment or poor investment performance.
A challenging capital markets backdrop from higher rates that delays exits and strategic or deal-driven asset flows.
Regulatory and balance sheet risk from the Athene ownership.
Higher cost of funds and a flattish net spread could pressure SRE, which MS models below the Street in 2028.
Management fee growth guidance of 15%+ is below consensus of 17%, and the lost MFIC and ARI fees weigh on 2027 fees.
vol_and_positioning: Options-implied risk-neutral probabilities as of Nov 3, 2026: ~18.6% chance of APO exceeding the $149 base case, ~12.6% chance of falling below the $67 bear case, and ~0.0% chance of exceeding the $255 bull case over 12 months.
Hedge fund sector long/short ratio is 1.5x with net exposure of 9.5%. Institutional owners are 60.8% active.

tension_points.bull_case: Record origination of $114b, a growing ACS fee stream and a 20%+ FRE growth guide for 2027 support MS 2027e EPS about 4% above consensus and a ~22% EPS CAGR through 2028, at ~10.9x 2027e P/E vs peers at ~13x.

tension_points.what_invalidates: A 4Q normalized SRE shortfall against mgmt's ~$1b expectation, since more than 60% of 3Q investments were deployed in September and should fully earn in during 4Q.
